## Facts and statements

- [statement] CCXT documents switching to an exchange sandbox only if the underlying exchange supports it, immediately after constructing the exchange and before any other call. The manual states that sandbox keys are not interchangeable with production keys. (low confidence) — https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/wiki/manual · keywords: Crypto bot monitor proposed drill and recovery oracles
